the  Commission  shall  hold  office  for    three
years, unless he,–

(i)
earlier  resigns  from  his  office,  by
letter addressed to the President;

(ii)
is removed from office as hereinafter
provided;  or

(iii)
becomes a Member of Parliament or
a member of a Provincial Council or
any local authority.

Commission shall be eligible to be appointed

and  with  the  approval  of  the  Constitutional
Council,  remove  from  office  any  person
